title: 💧 An Amazing Discovery: An Ancient Heavy-Water Reservoir Hidden Behind Neptune!
body: 💧 An Amazing Discovery: An Ancient Heavy-Water Reservoir Hidden Behind Neptune!

Scientists studied twelve microscopic dust grains collected by an aircraft from the upper atmosphere, and found that the density of radiation traces in them is 100 times higher than in asteroid-belt dust, suggesting they came from the distant Kuiper Belt. The analysis showed that their water carries a much higher proportion of heavy oxygen compared to asteroid water, pointing to an ancient reservoir of heavy water at the edges of the solar system. The scientists stress that the results are estimates based on a small sample, not direct measurements.
Simply put: tiny dust grains may reveal the secrets of the solar system’s first water.
Can you believe that dust carries the secrets of the beginning of the universe?
